title: Free diagrams are left adjoint to evaluation
statement: Let $J$ be a small category and let $\mathcal A$ be a category admitting coproducts indexed by every set $\operatorname{Hom}_J(j,k)$. For $j\in J$ and $M\in\mathcal A$, define $L_j(M)$ by $L_j(M)(k)=\coprod_{u:j\to k}M$; its map on $v:k\to k'$ sends the summand indexed by $u$ identically to the summand indexed by $v\circ u$. For a morphism $t:M\to N$, the component $L_j(t)_k$ sends each $M$ summand by $t$ to the $N$ summand with the same index. Then $L_j:\mathcal A\to\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal A)$ is left adjoint to evaluation at $j$. Its natural bijection is $\operatorname{Hom}(L_j(M),F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(M,F(j))$, sending $a$ to $a_j\circ\iota_{\operatorname{id}_j}$; the inverse sends $h:M\to F(j)$ to the natural transformation whose component at $k$ is induced by the maps $F(u)\circ h$ on the summands. These bijections commute with postcomposition by natural transformations. Colimits and their structure maps are as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; a coproduct is the colimit of the discrete diagram of its summands.
